protocol: Predeclared ABBA order per viewport/mode. Sequential fresh contexts in one Chromium SwiftShader. Native sound ON/start; wait for simulation time1.5s. Stationary stage1 x0 with normal idle animation and running rAF; moving stage3 via existing keyboard/touch driver. Both use five seconds of wall-clock rAF after warm-up, first10 intervals excluded, all raw intervals/states retained. Moving drivers continue through normal stage3 clear and save. Equal renderer/framebuffers asserted. No physics writes, paused/held rAF or passing-host reruns. This diagnostic is separate from unchanged45fps/p95<=40ms release gates.
